trial_court: Court of 1st Addl. Distt. Judge, Lakhnadon, District Seoni
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Wife prayed for transfer of petition under Section 13 of Hindu Marriage Act from Court of 1st Addl. Distt. Judge to Family Court, Seoni.

legal_principles.principle: The court may transfer a petition to another court if the applicant is facing difficulty in participating in the proceedings.
legal_principles.held: It would be convenient for her to attend proceedings in the Family Court at Seoni.
cited_cases: Santoshi Rai vs Prashant Rai on 3 November, 2023
Tejalben v. Mihirbhai Bharatbhai Kothari (2016) 3 SCC 69
Ruchi Rawat v. Principal Judge, Family Court, Etah and another 2022 SCC Online SC 2036
Manjula Singh Chouhan v. Vishal Singh Chouhan (2019) 13 SCC 660

legal_principles.principle: The court may not transfer a petition to another court if the applicant is not facing difficulty in participating in the proceedings.
legal_principles.held: He further submits that five cases are pending adjudication in the Courts at Seoni and Section 498-A of IPC regd. on the application of wife is pending adjudication before JMFC, Lakhnadon.
cited_cases: Manpreet Kaur v. Gurbaksh Singh TA

outcome.final_order: Transfer of petition granted from Court of 1st Addl. Distt. Judge to Family Court, Seoni.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for transfer of divorce case
advising on legal difficulties in family court proceedings
assisting with convenience issues in divorce cases
